ops.title: Release tags must be cut as yasyfm@gmail.com with the fleet key; v0.47.5 is burned
ops.body: The verify-tag-on-main gate requires GitHub API signature verification `reason: valid`, which demands the tagger email match the signing key's UID: cut release tags with `GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="Yasyf Mohamedali" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="yasyfm@gmail.com" git tag -s -u F3299DE3FE0F6C3CF2B66BFBF7ECDD88A700D73A vX.Y.Z -m "vX.Y.Z" origin/main`. A tag cut with the default git identity (yasyf@poetic.com) fails the gate with `bad_email`, and the repo ruleset forbids tag deletion, so the version number is permanently burned. v0.47.5 is burned this way (tag exists, no release); the fusekit v1.15.2 release shipped as v0.47.6 instead.
